# NoC_Chiplet_iNEST_Wafer

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-07-30

## Definition
A wafer-scale integration framework where Network-on-Chip (NoC) interconnects link multiple chiplets on a single iNEST wafer, forming a topology-centric computing substrate. This concept directly maps TCC's need for reconfigurable, high-bandwidth inter-chiplet communication onto a wafer-scale neuromorphic fabric, enabling efficient in-network computation.
